messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A stout quadrupedal creature shown in side three-quarter view facing right, with a broad flat pale gray amphibian-like head with large round eyes and feathery pink external gills, a pale smooth wrinkled underside and four short sturdy clawed limbs, and a high domed back and long tapering tail completely covered in large overlapping dark brown-gray keeled scales.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat smooth pale gray mottled amphibian-like head with wide blunt snout", "part": "head", "where": "at front right of body"}, {"looks_like": "large round protruding dark eyes with pale blue-gray irises", "part": "eyes", "where": "on sides of head"}, {"looks_like": "wide straight slightly upturned mouth line", "part": "mouth", "where": "across front of head below snout"}, {"looks_like": "small round nostril dots", "part": "nostrils", "where": "on top of snout"}, {"looks_like": "pink fleshy stalks with dense feathery red-pink filaments", "part": "gills", "where": "protruding from sides of head behind jaw, four per side"}, {"looks_like": "pale gray-white smooth wrinkled skin with segmented folds", "part": "underbelly", "where": "under scaled back between front and hind legs"}, {"looks_like": "short thick smooth pale gray limbs with wrinkled joints", "part": "legs", "where": "two at front under chest and two at rear under belly"}, {"looks_like": "broad five-toed feet with small dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at ends of each leg on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering muscular tail, scaled above", "part": "tail", "where": "extending left from rear of body out of frame"}, {"looks_like": "large overlapping keeled brown-gray armor-like scales", "part": "scales", "where": "covering entire back from neck to tail tip"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
